scope: Supplementary sampled diagnostics, not a ranked time. Resource window begins at child launch and ends at its processing-complete line, including import/seed setup outside the service timer. Output verification follows outside that window. RSS sums double-count shared pages and are not physical RAM; peaks may be missed; CPU is sampled. WAL is cluster-wide and can include control/checkpoints/other background work. Temp counters read after verification can also include verification work.
stage_observation_correction: The external observer cannot see an uncommitted catalog entry. Its NULL converted to zero was not a stage-size measurement. Other sampled metrics are retained; exact in-transaction stage observation is measured separately in v2.
